title: Machine Learning Engineering Manager
summary: Leads a team of machine learning and GenAI engineers and data scientists, owning hiring, growth and the delivery of models and LLM features into live products. Sits between the ML team, product and business, and answers for whether models work reliably in production, not for writing most of the code.
dailyDuties: Hold one-on-ones and coach ML engineers and data scientists
Review designs for training pipelines and model serving
Check model and LLM evaluation results before a release
Plan the ML roadmap and agree launch dates with product
Track production models for drift, cost and incidents
Write updates for leadership on model impact

skills.expectation: Hire, coach and run reviews for a team of ML engineers and data scientists
Set technical direction for ML work and grow senior engineers
Agree scope, launch dates and success metrics with product and business heads
Judge model choices and review the team's modelling work
Keep models in production with a registry, monitoring, retraining and rollback
Lead delivery of LLM and GenAI features such as RAG assistants into products
Review end-to-end designs for data, training and low-latency serving
Set offline and online metrics that decide whether a model ships
Read and review the team's Python code and prototypes
Plan and prioritise the ML roadmap with product
Set up eval sets and guardrails that gate LLM releases
Guide deep learning work with PyTorch or TensorFlow
Run training and inference on SageMaker, Vertex AI, Azure ML or Bedrock
Keep GPU and inference spend within budget
Apply responsible AI reviews, privacy and model risk checks
Run interview loops and grow the team

certifications.why: Shows production ML design on Google Cloud
Shows ML build and deploy on AWS
